label: Значить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for значить (to mean).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. Значить is normally used in the third person, so 'значит' with its -ит ending is the core form. The subject is the inanimate 'слово'.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Значат' takes the -ат ending for a plural subject 'знаки'. The double negation with 'ничего не' is the natural Russian pattern.

missions.phrase: Эта встреча много значит для меня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Present with dative benefactive. 'Значит' is third-person singular. 'Для меня' names the person for whom it matters, a very common idiom of importance.

missions.phrase: Твои слова значат для нас многое.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Значат' agrees with the plural subject 'слова'. 'Для нас' adds the для + genitive benefactive of value.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Значил' is the masculine -л past of значить, agreeing with 'символ'. 'Тогда' shifts the meaning into a past era.

missions.phrase: Эта песня значила для неё всё.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Значила' adds the feminine -ла ending, agreeing with 'песня'. 'Для неё всё' expresses total emotional importance.
Strategic focus: Past, neuter. 'Значило' is the neuter -ло form agreeing with neuter 'письмо'. A natural way to practise the rarer neuter past.
Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Значили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders, agreeing with 'традиции'. 'Раньше' contrasts past and present worth.
Strategic focus: Imperfective future, third-person. 'Будет' is the auxiliary and 'значить' stays infinitive, forming the compound future. Значить has no everyday perfective partner.

missions.phrase: Трудно понять, что это может значить.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Infinitive use. After the modal 'может', значить stays in the infinitive 'значить'. This shows the dictionary form inside a subordinate clause.
